description: Presidential Secretariat - Extension of the term of the Preliminary Commission on Human Rights
categorisation: This gazette content involves the extension of time for a Presidential Commission of Inquiry to submit its final report, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. It references the Commission of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393) and provides legal authority for the time extension, making it primarily about legal procedures and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any other specialized category.
